notes: The CUSTOM-LANE TYPE SWEEP brief bank (docs/NOACG_PRO_PLAN.md §21.2 follow-on). Seven graphic types, three fresh briefs each. Ids are stable - fixtures and results key off them. A lower-third entry keeps the legacy SpikeBrief shape (no graphicType key), so it runs the exact §21 protocol as the bridge; every other entry declares `graphicType` + `fields` (+ `steps` for steppers), which spikeUserMessage renders as that type's own field and step contract. THE PLATFORM AUTHORS STATE MACHINES, NOT THE MODEL (owner 2026-08-17): a stepper brief declares its steps as the SPX default path the operator walks with next(); the model implements window.next(), never a machine key. `expect.textFields` is the FLOOR of text-visible fields the runner scores (number-typed fields legitimately fall out of the count).

brief.brief: Financial evening bulletin: precise, quiet authority, hairline rules, tabular calm - a desk that reports numbers without drama.
brief.name: Tobias Ekholm
brief.title: Markets Editor

brief.brief: Late-night talk show: confident, warm, a little theatrical - stage-light energy without clutter, generous type.
brief.name: Rosa Delgado
brief.title: Tonight's Guest · Author

brief.brief: Esports broadcast desk: sharp, kinetic, angular - reads instantly over fast gameplay, tournament-grade polish.
brief.name: Yuki Tanaka
brief.title: Play-by-play Caster

brief.brief: Top-flight club football: a permanent match scoreboard for the top corner of the frame - two clubs, running clock, scores that BUMP live. Compact, unmissable, never in the way of play.
brief.name: Kestrel City
brief.title: Match scoreboard

brief.brief: Best-of-five esports grand final: series scoreboard - two teams, maps won, a bold series state. Neon-grade contrast, angular, built for a busy HUD.
brief.name: Pulse Arena
brief.title: Series scoreboard

brief.brief: Saturday family game show: a warm, friendly two-family score strip along the bottom - big cheerful numbers, round indicator, nothing cold or sporty about it.
brief.name: The Okafors
brief.title: Family score strip

brief.brief: Primetime million-euro quiz: the question board - one question, four answers in a 2x2 or stacked ladder, dramatic but disciplined. The stakes should be visible in the design.
brief.name: Question board
brief.title: Primetime quiz

fields.title: Question
fields.sample: Which planet has the longest day?
fields.stress: Which of these four European capital cities sits at the confluence of two major rivers and was founded under a different name by the Romans?

fields.title: Answer A
fields.stress: Venus, the second planet from the Sun

fields.title: Answer B
fields.stress: Mars, the fourth planet from the Sun

fields.title: Answer D
fields.stress: Jupiter, the largest planet in the system

steps: reveal the four answers (the question alone is on screen first)
lock the operator's selected answer (field f5) - it visibly commits, the others recede
reveal the correct answer (field f6) - right answer celebrates, a wrong locked answer reads clearly as wrong

brief.brief: Inter-university academic quiz league: scholarly, typographic, calm - a question board that respects the audience's intelligence. No gold, no glitz.
brief.name: Question board
brief.title: Academic quiz

fields.title: Question
fields.stress: Which nineteenth-century economist's collected correspondence, published posthumously in eleven volumes, reversed the scholarly consensus on his best-known theory?

fields.title: Answer A
fields.stress: Alfred Wegener, meteorologist and polar researcher

fields.title: Answer B
fields.stress: Charles Lyell, author of Principles of Geology

fields.title: Answer C
fields.stress: James Hutton, the father of modern geology

steps: reveal the four answers (the question alone is on screen first)
lock the operator's selected answer (field f5) - it visibly commits, the others recede
reveal the correct answer (field f6) - right answer celebrates, a wrong locked answer reads clearly as wrong

brief.brief: Esports trivia segment between maps: fast, loud, arena-screen energy - a quiz board that holds up on a jumbotron and on stream at once.
brief.name: Question board
brief.title: Arena trivia

fields.title: Question
fields.sample: Which map has hosted the most finals?
fields.stress: Which map, introduced in the third competitive season and reworked twice since, has hosted the most grand-final deciding rounds across all major tournaments?

steps: reveal the four answers (the question alone is on screen first)
lock the operator's selected answer (field f5) - it visibly commits, the others recede
reveal the correct answer (field f6) - right answer celebrates, a wrong locked answer reads clearly as wrong

brief.brief: Investigative newsroom rolling ticker: a continuous bottom strip cycling short headlines - ink-on-paper discipline, a clear section label, headlines never truncated mid-word.
brief.name: Ticker
brief.title: News ticker

fields.title: Headlines (one per line)
fields.sample:
Court releases sealed filings in port authority case
Ministry confirms audit of regional grants
Transit strike enters third day
fields.stress:
Court releases sealed filings in port authority case after eleven-month appeal by three news organisations
Ministry confirms sweeping audit of regional development grants covering the last nine fiscal years
Transit strike enters third day as union rejects arbitration framework proposed by the mediator
Harbour expansion review finds undisclosed conflicts across two councils
Whistleblower testimony moved to closed session

brief.brief: Nature documentary channel: a gentle facts ticker for live event coverage (migration night) - unhurried crawl, organic warmth, readable at a glance.
brief.name: Ticker
brief.title: Facts ticker

fields.title: Facts (one per line)
fields.sample:
Arctic terns fly up to 90,000 km in a year
Cranes navigate by landmark, star and wind
The flock left the delta 41 minutes ago
fields.stress:
Arctic terns fly up to ninety thousand kilometres in a single migratory year, the longest of any animal
Common cranes navigate by a layered map of landmark, star pattern and prevailing wind memory
The lead flock left the river delta forty-one minutes ago and is tracking the coastal ridge north
Juveniles fly their first full migration with no adult in front of them
Tonight's crossing is the longest open-water leg of the route

brief.brief: Transfer-deadline sports ticker: urgent, punchy, club-neutral dark strip with the network's volt energy - BREAKING items must visibly outrank routine ones.
brief.name: Ticker
brief.title: Transfer ticker

fields.title: Items (one per line)
fields.sample:
BREAKING: Okafor completes medical at Northbridge
Loan move for Virtanen agreed, option to buy
City reject second bid for Delgado
fields.stress:
BREAKING: Okafor completes medical at Northbridge ahead of club-record permanent transfer
Season-long loan for Virtanen agreed with an option to buy set above the release clause
City reject a second and final bid for Delgado, describing the valuation as derisory
BREAKING: paperwork filed two minutes before the window closed, league confirmation pending
Free agent Marchetti training with the reserves from Monday

brief.brief: Election night: a full-screen headline statistic - one number the whole story turns on, with its claim and source. Institutional calm, data-driven confidence, generous canvas.
brief.name: Stat panel
brief.title: Election stat

fields.title: Claim
fields.stress: The highest national turnout in twenty-four years, exceeding every district's four-election average

fields.title: Source
fields.stress: Electoral Commission provisional count, 2 314 of 2 340 districts reporting as of 23:41 local time

brief.brief: Science documentary: a full-screen statistic that must feel vast and quiet - one measured number over an implied landscape, museum-plaque restraint.
brief.name: Stat panel
brief.title: Climate stat

fields.title: Claim
fields.stress: The second-lowest September extent in the forty-six-year satellite record, 38% below the 1981-2010 median

fields.title: Source
fields.stress: National Snow and Ice Data Center passive-microwave satellite record, provisional September mean

brief.brief: Half-time football analysis: a full-screen match statistic with attitude - one dominant number, the claim it proves, sharp angular energy that still reads in a pub.
brief.name: Stat panel
brief.title: Match stat

fields.title: Claim
fields.sample: Kestrel City's most one-sided half this season
fields.stress: Kestrel City's most one-sided first half this season by expected goals, despite trailing on the actual scoreline

fields.title: Source
fields.stress: Official league optical tracking data, all competitions, provisional at half-time

brief.brief: Live rocket-launch special on a science channel: a countdown to the window opening - the clock is the hero, calm precision, and under one minute the design must visibly change gear (emphasis, not panic).
brief.name: Countdown
brief.title: Launch countdown

brief.brief: Election results programme: a countdown to the first exit poll at nine - typographic, newsroom-severe, the tension carried by type alone. Under a minute, the final seconds must land one by one.
brief.name: Countdown
brief.title: Exit poll countdown

brief.brief: Saturday family show: the audience-warm-up countdown to going live - playful, bouncing warmth, a clock children read as easily as adults. The last ten seconds should invite the room to count along.
brief.name: Countdown
brief.title: Show countdown

fields.title: Event label
fields.stress: THE SUNBEAM SATURDAY SPECTACULAR IS ON IN

brief.brief: Athletics championship medal ceremony: the final top three, revealed third-to-first as the operator steps - podium heights matter, gold lands last and largest. Formal but electric.
brief.name: Podium
brief.title: Medal podium

fields.title: Event title
fields.stress: WOMEN'S 800 METRES CHAMPIONSHIP FINAL · NATIONAL RECORD

reveal first place - the winner lands last, largest, unmistakably on top

brief.brief: Election night: the three largest parties by projected seats, revealed third-to-first - sober institutional drama, the bar or panel heights proportional to the numbers.
brief.name: Podium
brief.title: Seats top three

reveal the second-largest party above it
reveal the largest party - it lands last and reads as the story
